_metadata.description: Substance identity registry. Ingested source snapshots are the primary intended input (npm run substances:ingest). This first curated block exists because the hazard registers structurally cannot supply it: registers of prohibitions only list prohibited things, so nothing in them ever resolves an ordinary label term like 'sugar' or 'citric acid'. These entries carry the identities that health-guidance evidence attaches to. Aliases are EXACT-match after normalization, so each printed label form must be listed explicitly — an unlisted variant resolves to unidentified, which is the safe direction. 2026-08-12: added Chinese and Spanish label forms for every substance here. Cross-language scans were partly bypassing this registry — 白砂糖 resolved but bare 糖 did not — so a Chinese label fell back to the model for substances we hold records on. Partially-hydrogenated-oil forms are all explicitly PARTIAL; fully hydrogenated oil is a different ingredient and must not resolve here.
